definitions.explanation: The father of one's grandfather or grandmother.

examples.japanese: {曽祖父|そうそふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧だった。
{曽祖父|そうそふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Only one photo of my great-grandfather survives.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{曽祖父|そうそふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This house was built by my great-grandfather at the end of the Meiji era.

notes:
REGISTER:
- Like ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧, {曽祖父|そうそふ} belongs to writing and formal speech, and is used for one's own family. In conversation people say ひい⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ or ひい⟦おじいちゃん→おじいちゃん：20642_ojiichan⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- {曽祖母|そうそぼ}: great-grandmother
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧: grandfather
- {曽孫|ひまご}: great-grandchild

WRITING:
- Also written {曾祖父|そうそふ}, with the traditional form of the first kanji.
